blocks.text: Days after announcing that they are back together as a couple, Katrina Halili and Kris Lawrence are taking things slow this time, with their daughter Katie as their topmost priority. Speaking to entertainment reporters for the first time since their admission that they are again in a relationship, Halili and Lawrence said that while they are enjoying their second go at romance, they have not yet really discussed marriage and having a wedding.
